title: Anthoni usque limina (Busnoys)
desc: Antoine Busnoys, Anthoni usque limina. 5 voices (Discantus 1, Discantus 2, Altus, Bell, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Bus2004); encoded by Jesse Rodin. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
